# RotaSphere — Rotaract District 3192 Digital Infrastructure

> RotaSphere is the official event discovery, delegate registration, and ticketing platform for Rotaract District 3192 (Bengaluru, Tumakuru, Kolar, Chikkaballapura, Ramanagara).

## Key Information
- **District**: Rotaract District 3192
- **Rotary International Zone**: 5
- **Total Chartered Clubs**: 85+ clubs across 6 zones (Taranga, Varuna, Samudhra, Sagara, Pravaha, Arnava)
- **Primary Use**: Event Ticketing, Delegate Passes, QR Check-in, Club Governance, District Gallery

## Public Endpoints
- Homepage: https://rotaract3192.org/
- Explore Events & Passes: https://rotaract3192.org/events
- Chartered Clubs Directory: https://rotaract3192.org/clubs
- District Photo Gallery: https://rotaract3192.org/gallery
- Attendee Tickets & Passes: https://rotaract3192.org/tickets
- About District 3192: https://rotaract3192.org/district
- Help & Support: https://rotaract3192.org/help
- Contact: https://rotaract3192.org/contact

## Platform Capabilities
- Instant ticket generation with encrypted QR passes for gate check-in.
- Multi-tier ticket configurations (Early Bird, Standard, VIP, Rotary Sponsor).
- Searchable directory of all 85 chartered clubs with president contacts and partner Rotary sponsors.
